blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation inside Insurance & Risk: the operating realities we design for, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

In Insurance & Risk, agentic ai & hyperautomation turns knowledge work into orchestrated autonomy. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: agentic process automation, digital workforce & multi-agent orchestration, decision intelligence systems — delivered on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: FNOL packets, medical reports, repair estimates and police files arrive as unstructured documents; manual triage queues claims for days before an adjuster sees them. Leakage and customer patience both bleed in the queue.
Organized fraud rings exploit application and claims patterns across carriers faster than rule updates. SIU teams work leads generated by thresholds tuned for last year's fraud.

GLM-based pricing, telematics factors and external data enrichment multiply model complexity faster than validation capacity. Filings get challenged; model risk documentation is reconstructed under exam pressure.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

Delivery composes 7 services from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower — Agentic Process Automation, Digital Workforce & Multi-Agent Orchestration, Decision Intelligence Systems, Intelligent Document Processing as the usual core — sequenced through the Dataq Method, with DORA (for EU insurers) obligations shaping the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: Agents that execute the work: tool-using, policy-bounded, and fully logged for audit.
Agents operated as one fleet: roles, queues, budgets and audit trails.
Decision paths that run in milliseconds, with policy checks and full logging.
Contracts, claims and invoices read end-to-end: extraction, validation and downstream action.
Documents classified, extracted and routed with confidence thresholds; straight-through for clean claims (triage queue clearance in minutes)
Entity-link analytics scoring claims and applications against ring patterns (organized-fraud capture up 25%+)
Hours for SME classes with agentic workbenches

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: DORA (for EU insurers) and Solvency II / NAIC RBC regimes. Reserving, capital and model governance under supervisory review. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

This capability runs on the cadence set out below; the rhythm is fixed, the scope is signed. Weeks 1–2 belong to measurement: the baseline metric is captured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 run a bounded pilot — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — steered by a control owner on your side. Weeks 9–12 convert the pilot into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, and close with a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses a gate is stopped or redirected on the record.
